en: A vintage black-and-white postcard depicting a small village nestled in a hilly, forested landscape. The central focus is a cluster of stone buildings, including a church with a bell tower, likely from medieval times. In the foreground, there are several people walking or standing on a rocky path next to a distinctive vertical rock formation. The postcard has French text at the top and along the left side.
